editorial: Malaysia delivered very good value to us.

Reference points: a 16-kilometre Grab in Kuala Lumpur cost RM17.50, ten beef satay sticks were RM20, the Langkawi island-hopping tour was RM40, Dayang Bunting entry RM20 per person and the lake kayak RM25. The Sky Bridge cable car was the outlier at RM90 per person.
Food and local transport were cheap enough that we rarely felt the need to optimise every purchase.

alternatives.title: What if we had a bigger budget?
editorial: We'd upgrade the Langkawi stay and book a better private or small-group boat day. Kuala Lumpur did not make us crave luxury because so much of its pleasure comes from streets, markets and casual food.

alternatives.title: What if we had a smaller budget?
editorial: This itinerary already works well on one. Stay near transit in KL, eat at kopitiams and hawker-style restaurants, use Grab selectively and spend Langkawi days on the beach rather than buying every activity.
